name: torture-resume
description: MID-FLIGHT KILL AND RESUME. The suite starts the run, waits until `slow` has actually begun, kills the driver's whole process tree, and then runs a PLAIN `resume` — no --force-unlock. That is the property under test: the killed run leaves its lockfile behind, and `acquire_lock` clears it only because the recorded pid is dead on this host (SPEC §10.3). Expected: exit 0, `first` NOT re-run (its input hash still matches, so resume serves it from the record), `slow` run twice (it never completed), and `last` reached. Only the first invocation of `slow` sleeps; the resumed one returns immediately.
